term check (each part is fitted together with free curves that stand in for the terms it leaves out):
- the terms that mix inputs, (params[3] * T ** params[4] / (1 + params[5] * eps)): RIGHT, keep this part as it is
- the terms in eps alone, (params[1] * eps ** params[2]): NOT right, change this part
- the terms in T alone, (params[0] * np.sqrt(T)): RIGHT, keep this part as it is
